cart_subtotal = cart['base_cost'] + cart['gift_wrap_fee'] - cart['discount']

print('cart_gift_wrap_fee', cart['gift_wrap_fee'])

wishlist_subtotal = sum(item['price'] * item['quantity'] for item in wish)
print('wishlist_items', len(wish))
